rules.message: Synchronous setState at the top of useEffect triggers redundant render cascades or stale entity resets; retrieve effect-boundaries-and-derived-state.
keepWhen: Controlled editor intentionally preserves unsaved local edits across parent prop refreshes and reconciles only when an explicit external revision token increments.
State transition measures committed DOM layout geometry that cannot be computed before paint.
dropWhen: Match occurs inside a unit test fixture, code comment, or external browser observer callback.

rules.message: focus:outline-none strips the keyboard focus ring without a focus-visible replacement on the same line; retrieve async-ux-and-accessibility-behaviors.
keepWhen: Inner control sits inside a composite field shell whose parent container renders a visible has-[:focus-visible]:ring-2 indicator.
dropWhen: Element already applies focus-visible:ring-* or focus-visible:outline-* on an adjacent line inside cn() or cva().
Occurrence is inside a negative scanner test fixture or markdown snippet.
